- /Users/swapnil/Documents/thyroid-fatloss-app/lib/labs/dates.ts — the date row. "collected on" is a COLLECTED label and outranks "reported on", so a report printing both resolves to the collection date; kindOf() passes it through titleCase(), giving exactly "Collected on", and the component renders `Read "Collected on" from the report.` — quoted verbatim here.
- /Users/swapnil/Documents/thyroid-fatloss-app/app/globals.css — confirmed the palette (#090c14, #e8eaf0 / #a9b2c1 / #7e8a9e / #5a6578, #2dd4bf, #34d399) and --radius: 1.25rem, so under Tailwind v4 rounded-2xl = 32px and rounded-xl = 26px; rounded-3xl is not overridden in @theme inline and stays 24px. Fonts: Instrument Serif and Satoshi are declared but self-hosted/Fontshare, so the italic display falls back to Georgia here exactly as it does in the app on a device without them.
- Icons hand-inlined from lucide-react 0.564.0 __iconNode path data: ArrowLeft, Upload, X, LoaderCircle (the Loader2 export), FileText, CalendarCheck, ShieldCheck. FileText's geometry changed in this version, so it was copied from node_modules rather than memory.

Approximations, all deliberate and all disclosed:

1. The real "reading" phase is only a centred spinner and one status line. The brief asked to show the mechanism, so the file chip, the progress bar, the "Text on page 2" preview and the "Read so far" list are additions, built in the component's own idioms (26px rows on rgba(255,255,255,0.03) with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) hairline, the 10px/0.14em uppercase panel label from LabGauges, the serif-italic value + small unit row). Nothing here contradicts what the code does — it renders intermediate state the code holds but does not currently paint.
2. Report-text lines. "TSH  1.77  mIU/L  0.35 - 4.94" and "Collected On : 10/05/2026" are her real values and her real sample date. The surrounding lines — the report header, "Reported On : 11/05/2026" and the half-read "Method : CLIA, Serum" — are typical Indian-lab furniture, not measurements. "Reported On" earns its place because it is what makes the collected-beats-reported ranking in dates.ts visible. The page count (3) and "page 2/3" are file facts, not clinical ones.
3. No other marker is shown with a value, so this screen carries no invented figure and the example-figures disclaimer would have been untrue — it would have labelled her one real result as a sample. In its place the muted grey line "Only what the report prints can be read. On this report that is TSH — tests that were not run stay empty." does the same protective job accurately, and matches the earlier labs screen, where Free T3, Free T4 and Anti-TPO appear as "not tested".
4. TSH carries no badge, no colour and no comment. Nothing on the screen interprets the value, and amber is absent because nothing is out of range.
5. BottomNavPill is omitted: /dashboard/health does not mount it (it lives in app/dashboard/dashboard-client.tsx), and the sheet would cover that region regardless.
6. position:fixed became absolute inside .s7-screen (which is position:relative) so the overlay stays inside the 390x844 frame; the spinner is frozen mid-rotation instead of animating.

Verified in headless Chrome at 390x844, 2x device scale: sheet spans y=185.8 to 844, page scrollWidth 390 / scrollHeight 844 with no overflow, no element extends past the frame, and the smallest type is 10px (the two uppercase labels).

Gauge geometry is computed with the component's own maths, not eyeballed: pad = max(span*0.35, |value − midpoint|*0.15), min = min(low − pad, value), max = max(high + pad, value). That yields the band at 20.59%–79.41% for six markers, 11.69%–32.40% for Anti-TPO, and puts the Anti-TPO dot exactly at 100% (value == scale max), so it sits centred on the bar's right end — that overhang is the real component's behaviour, not a mistake.

Same pill, same colours, same words — one line lower.

REPRODUCED EXACTLY: step dots (STEP_KEYS gives 8 dots before completion; passed dots 24px teal, upcoming 6px at rgba(255,255,255,0.1); container px-6 py-6, gap 1.5). Back chevron absolutely placed at top-8/left-6 in a p-2 rounded-lg rgba(255,255,255,0.04) tile — it does sit level with the dots in the real app. Step body px-6 py-8, space-y-8. Mood is five tap cards (Frown, Frown, Meh, Smile, Smile — the app renders icons only, the labels in the array are never shown), p-3, rounded-xl, selected card rgba(45,212,191,0.15) + rgba(45,212,191,0.3) border with a #2dd4bf icon. CTA: full width, py-4, pill, 135deg #2dd4bf→#22c55e, 0 0 32px teal glow.

WHY THIS STEP AND NOT THE ONE ASKED FOR: weight, measurements and the symptom checklist are three SEPARATE steps of the same wizard (steps 4, 5 and 6), each its own full-screen paint. They cannot appear together on one 844px frame without inventing a screen the app does not render. I chose FeelingsStep because it is the only step that carries both control types the brief named — sliders and tap cards — and because it is early enough to read as "being filled in". The dots show 1 of 8 done. There is also no "mental clarity" slider anywhere in the flow; brain fog is one of the six symptoms on the later SymptomsStep, scored None/Mild/Moderate/Severe.

DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS FROM SOURCE (all four are the no-red rule or dev debris):
1. Stress slider value is #f59e0b amber here; the source renders it #ef4444 red. Red on her own number is banned.
2. Stress track is drawn as a 60% amber fill. Worth flagging as a real bug: the live gradient computes `(10 - data.stress / 10) * 100`, which for any stress 1-10 yields 900-990%, so the track paints entirely #34d399 green regardless of the answer. Reproducing that faithfully would show a full bar next to the number 6. The intended maths is `((10 - stress) / 10) * 100`.
3. Dropped the paragraph under the Stress slider. Its literal string in source is "Supportive microcopy: Stress is temporary. You're doing great." — the dev prefix is still in the shipped copy, and I would not fabricate a replacement.
4. The Medication counter on the next step (ActionsStep) is not shown; that step is not this screen anyway, but noting it was consciously avoided.

APPROXIMATED: the slider thumb. The app sets appearance-none on the <input type=range> and never styles ::-webkit-slider-thumb, so it inherits Chrome's default knob; I drew a 14px light circle at the value position, which is what Chrome paints.

ADDED, NOT APP COPY: the muted grey line under the button. The check-in flow has no such line — it is the mandated disclosure that 6 / 4 / 5 / 6 are example answers, since Poonam's only measured value is TSH 1.77. It also carries "Week 6", because the flow itself displays no week number anywhere in its chrome.

OTHER: no bottom nav pill on this route — the check-in is a full-screen wizard outside the tabbed dashboard shell. The empty ground below the button is faithful: the step is min-h-screen with content flowing from the top, and this step's content ends around y=626 on an 844px device. No serif is used on this step; it has no heading. Verified by headless Chrome screenshot at 390x844.
